summary: Deliver a secure, SaaS-ready RMM platform that lets MSPs manage branded client environments through tenant-isolated monitoring, automation, and endpoint operations.

milestones.title: SaaS tenancy and MSP control plane
milestones.description: Establish MSP, client, and site tenancy; scoped authorization; branding; custom-domain foundations; enrollment; and tenant-isolated data access.

milestones.title: Durable job orchestration
milestones.description: Provide transactional dispatch, agent acknowledgements, result replay, cancellation, expiry, retry, and per-target execution state.

milestones.title: Endpoint operations and technician console
milestones.description: Deliver capability-aware endpoint actions, approval workflows, maintenance and offline handling, immutable audit evidence, inventory ingestion, and browser-tested technician workflows.

milestones.title: Production beta hardening
milestones.description: Complete deployment automation, observability, backup and recovery exercises, upgrade validation, load testing, and operator runbooks for an MSP beta.

milestones.title: Hosted MSP service launch
milestones.description: Launch managed tenancy, subscription and entitlement operations, branded MSP portals, custom-domain onboarding, agent distribution, and service-level reporting.

milestones.title: Advanced monitoring and remediation
milestones.description: Expand network monitoring, automated remediation, vulnerability and patch intelligence, reporting, multi-region resilience, and enterprise deployment options.
